name: Startup India
description: Founders, early employees and students building or dreaming of startups in India.
audience: Indian founders and aspiring founders, 20 to 32
tone: Direct, a bit blunt, numbers when possible, light desi startup humour. No hype words.
exampleHooks: Your startup does not have a funding problem. It has a nobody-wants-this problem.
I quit a 30 lakh job for a startup that made 400 rupees.
Stop building. Nobody asked for this feature.
defaultStyle: cinematic, late-night co-working space, warm desk lamps, purple and amber tones, shallow depth of field

name: Campus Life
description: College students talking about exams, placements, hostels, friendships and what college is really like.
tone: Relatable, funny, slightly self-roasting. Sounds like a hostel roommate at 2 AM.
exampleHooks: Your CGPA is not the problem. Your LinkedIn is.
Nobody tells you this about first year.
The group project friend who does nothing is winning at life.
defaultStyle: candid documentary photo, Indian college campus, soft evening light, warm tones, slight film grain

name: Fit Together
description: People who work out, run or are trying to start, sharing routines, wins and honest struggles.
audience: Beginners and regular gym-goers in India, 18 to 35
tone: Encouraging but honest. No shaming, no miracle claims. Practical and a little cheeky.
topicsToCover: eating enough protein on a budget
exampleHooks: You are not lazy. Your plan is just too big.
The gym is not judging you. They are all checking themselves.
Three months of walking beat my six months of gym.
defaultStyle: dynamic sports photography, early morning light, strong contrast, deep purple and orange accents

name: Indie Gamers
description: Mobile and PC gamers who share clips, setups, hot takes and game recommendations.
tone: Fast, playful, opinionated. Friendly trash talk, never toxic.
topicsToCover: gaming with a job or exams
exampleHooks: Your aim is fine. Your ping is the villain.
The best game I played this year was free.
Every squad has this one teammate. If you cannot find him, it is you.
defaultStyle: neon-lit gaming desk, RGB glow, purple and cyan light, cinematic close-ups, shallow depth of field

name: Creator Circle
description: Small creators, musicians, designers and writers growing an audience and learning the craft.
audience: Indian creators with under 10k followers, 18 to 30
tone: Supportive, craft-focused, honest about the grind. Zero guru energy.
topicsToCover: making money from a small audience
exampleHooks: You have 2,000 followers. How many would notice if you left?
Your best post took 10 minutes. Your worst took 10 hours.
Stop asking for feedback from people who never post.
defaultStyle: editorial lifestyle photo, creative desk with camera and notebook, soft window light, purple and peach tones

name: Money Basics
description: Young earners sharing how they save, spend and think about money. Conversations, not advice.
tone: Calm, clear, zero jargon, slightly funny about being broke by the 20th.
exampleHooks: Your salary is not small. Your subscriptions are big.
I tracked every rupee for 30 days. One line shocked me.
Why is it rude to ask a friend what they earn?
defaultStyle: clean minimal still life, wallet, phone and chai on a desk, soft daylight, purple and gold accents
